findings.evidence: This commit changes the DDL owner election etcd client to be keyspace-namespaced: `pkg/ddl/owner_mgr.go:71` calls `etcd.SetEtcdCliByNamespace(cli, keyspace.MakeKeyspaceEtcdNamespace(store.GetCodec()))` before creating the owner manager (`pkg/ddl/owner_mgr.go:74`). The namespace prefix is `"/keyspaces/tidb/<keyspaceID>"` for API V2 (`pkg/keyspace/keyspace.go:36`). Keyspace mode (API V2) is enabled when `keyspaceName != ""` (`pkg/store/driver/tikv_driver.go:202`). DDL instances use `globalOwnerManager` for real-TiKV owner election when etcd is present (`pkg/ddl/ddl.go:673`). The first-parent version did not set any namespace, so it campaigned under the unprefixed `DDLOwnerKey` (`/tidb/ddl/fg/owner`).
findings.fix:
Decide/encode an explicit upgrade strategy for keyspace (API V2) deployments to avoid split-brain owners:
- Option A (safety-first): detect presence of legacy unprefixed owner keys and refuse to start (or disable DDL owner campaign) with a clear error telling operators to stop all old TiDB nodes first.
- Option B (compat window): during a deprecation window, ensure new nodes still coordinate with legacy election (e.g., take a global compat lock) so old+new cannot both act as owner simultaneously.
Also document the operational requirement for keyspace-mode upgrades.
findings.impact: In keyspace (API V2) deployments, mixed-version rolling upgrades can create two independent DDL owner elections (legacy unprefixed vs new keyspace-prefixed). This can yield two concurrent “owners” for the same keyspace, risking concurrent DDL job execution and background owner-only tasks (e.g., dead lock cleanup), which can corrupt or stall metadata/state-machine progress.
findings.verify:
Run a mixed-version keyspace-name cluster:
- Start at least one old-version TiDB and one new-version TiDB against the same keyspace.
- Inspect etcd for both prefixes: legacy `/tidb/ddl/fg/owner/` and namespaced `/keyspaces/tidb/<id>/tidb/ddl/fg/owner/`.
- Confirm at most one effective owner is active (only one processes DDL jobs / owner-only loops) throughout the upgrade window.
findings.what: Keyspace (API V2) rolling upgrade split-brain risk: DDL owner election keyspace prefix change makes old and new versions campaign on different etcd paths, allowing multiple concurrent DDL owners.

subject: ddl: Fix ddl owner doesn't use etcd keyspace prefix (#60403)
summary: Adds keyspace namespacing to the DDL owner election etcd client; this fixes cross-keyspace contention but can cause mixed-version keyspace-mode upgrades to have split-brain DDL owners due to the changed election path.
